answer: An AI economy resists Sybil attacks by tying each vote to a staked, attestable identity: lock a bond, get a signed credential, and vote only if two credited agents vouch for your lineage. Fake nodes must reference real ones, so a hollow ring of self-vouching bots is flagged. The attacker then pays a fresh bond per identity, so cost grows with every vote and an ivory facade of bots stays expensive. Like a lotus needing roots, each account needs collateral; duplicate an identity and you duplicate the bond, while caught rings are slashed, so the attack never pays.
